subject: Unable to use 'quantmod' CRAN package on shinyapps.io due to its dependency on a 'R-Forge' hosted package

messages.author: 5b8316dc05fc1e1e
messages.subject: Unable to use 'quantmod' CRAN package on shinyapps.io due to its dependency on a 'R-Forge' hosted package
parts:
I am getting the following error when trying to deploy my applications on shinyapps.io that uses 'quantmod' to visualize and analyze stock information.  

Uploading application bundle...Error: 
* Unable to deploy package dependency 'zoo'
  
  The package was installed from an unsupported repository 'R-Forge'.
  Only packages installed from CRAN, BioConductor and GitHub are
  supported.
Execution halted

It would be very useful to get dependencies for CRAN packages. It looks like 'zoo' is a very common dependency for CRAN packages.

Are there any options or workaround to get 'quantmod' to work on shinyapps.io

Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Unable to use 'quantmod' CRAN package on shinyapps.io due to its dependency on a 'R-Forge' hosted package
parts:
Ruslan,

The zoo package is on CRAN: http://cran.rstudio.org/web/packages/zoo/index.html

Also, quantmod does not depend on the zoo package.

-Andy
